diagnosis.observedFailure: Prior V3 budget epoch contained functionally correct candidates becoming incorrect during quality repair; public exception enrichment then showed no acceptance gain.
diagnosis.developmentReproduction: Two separately synthesized E3 test-double reproductions exercised the real quality-repair driver; independent private scoring rejects loss of cross-chunk carry and changed nonlinear update ordering. Not recovered NYX source or model-generated reasoning.
diagnosis.testedMechanism: Existing bounded native Super reasoning; identical corrected V3 policy, strict grammar and public original-state/structure-site guidance in both arms. No new cognition layer.

localDefectsFoundAndCorrected.detail: Hand-computed rectangle union was 22; independent unit-cell oracle and coordinate-partition witness agree on 21. Corrected before freeze.

New coefficient fixture initially reused an old decimal-task identity and overwrote its test-only witness. Assigned a distinct identity, restored the historical witness, added collision regression; all historical tests pass.

diagnosis.taskNovelty: New fixture instances, not proven pretraining-unseen or novel algorithm families. Decimal rounding has prior development relatives.

research.finding: Provider exposes none/high native reasoning and bounded reasoning_budget. Documentation is not efficacy evidence.

outcome.partialEvidence: Native reasoning produced functionally correct geometry in both repeats where control failed; no additional fully accepted solutions. Functionality alone is not quality admission.
outcome.correctlyDistinguishedPublicOnlyRegressi: Native decimal repeat 1 initially passed public cases but failed private cases before its quality repair; its later public failure is NOT loss of an initially fully correct solution.
outcome.limits: Four unique same-author tasks with two repeats, not an official benchmark score, eight independent domains, broad model superiority, or evidence of >=80% across benchmarks.
outcome.minimumGeneralNextInvestigation: Quality-constrained coherent algorithm redesign on separate development tasks: native reasoning increased functional acceptance but failed to translate unchanged complexity/declaration feedback into fully admitted candidates. Do not weaken limits, seed these exposed solutions, or add cognitive layers without a specific validated job.
outcome.failureEtiologyLimit: Raw candidate source and reasoning were not retained; exact statement-level causes of the valid-source failures cannot be reconstructed from digests. Public/quality/private-stage classification is observed, not guessed.

resources.measurementLimitations: Reported token/call and scheduled verifier/scorer proxies, not GPU FLOPs or total host CPU. Arm wall time includes host diagnostics and execution, not inference latency alone.

report.hypothesis: Existing bounded native reasoning improves full acceptance or prevents behavior-destroying quality repair on fresh unseeded tasks under identical corrected V3 policy, grammar, feedback, authority and shared caps. Realized extra compute must be reported, not called compute-matched merely because caps match. Previous exposed/V2 results are not regraded.
report.falsification: No reproducible gain in quality-accepted repairs or reduced repair cost on fresh tasks at matched realized compute, or any weakened gate.
